response.note: Attempt-level UPI success rate for August 2026 (assumes status value 'SUCCESS' and payment_method value 'UPI'; adjust if the data uses different labels).
response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_attempts, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS success_rate_pct FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE payment_method = 'UPI' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' LIMIT 50
